arStrings.szText: {c_important}The Seeker{/c} constantly makes all enemies in its area {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}.
Elites hit twice by {c_important}The Seeker{/c} have a {c_number}[{SF_17}*100|%|]{/c} chance to refund a Charge, doubled against Bosses.
{c_important}The Seeker{/c} drops {c_number}{SF_32}{/c} {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c} when it swoops down.

{c_important}The Seeker's{/c} first hit Knocks Down enemies for {c_number}[{buffduration:KNOCKDOWN}]{/c} seconds and leaves behind a {c_important}{u}Spirit Storm{/u}{/c} that Sparks enemies for {c_number}{dot:TOOLTIP_LIGHTNING_DOT}{/c} damage
{c_important}The Seeker{/c} now only has {c_number}1{/c} Charge, its area is increased by {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|%|]{/c}, and it deals {c_number}[{SF_29}*100|%|]{/c} increased damage.

{c_important}The Seeker{/c} is also a {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skill. 

The Jaguar Spirit aids {c_important}The Seeker{/c}, granting you {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} and slashing {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} times dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_DAMAGE}{/c} Fire Damage. {c_important}The Seeker{/c} gains {c_number}[SF_26]{/c} additional Charges.
